Context: 12. Payment of Gratuity under NPS Rules

4. Residuary Gratuity.When an employee dies within five years after retirement, and the total amount actually received by him on account of such annuity under National Pension System together with the retirement gratuity admissible are less that the amount equal to twelve times of his emoluments, a residuary gratuity equal to the deficiency is granted to his family. This is 'Residuary Gratuity'. - Rule 22 (4).
